title: Optimize server Vercel deployment to skip unnecessary site/docs installation
body:
When deploying `apps/server` to Vercel, the install command was installing all monorepo packages including `apps/site`, triggering unnecessary `fumadocs-mdx` postinstall scripts and slowing down builds.

## Changes

- **apps/server/vercel.json**: Added `--filter @object-ui/server...` to `installCommand` to install only server and its workspace dependencies

```json
"installCommand": "cd ../.. && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @object-ui/server..."
```

## Impact

- Faster Vercel deployments (fewer packages to install)
- Skips `apps/site` postinstall that was causing unnecessary fumadocs-mdx builds
- Server deployment remains fully independent from documentation site
